readerCopy.headline: Everything wants a bigger share of the same week.
readerCopy.body:
The calendar fills, the budget loosens, and every opportunity looks manageable while you are saying yes. Several plans can peak at once. Spending can grow because the future feels generous. A commitment that looked easy in isolation can become expensive once it is sitting beside the other three commitments you also meant.

Jupiter square Jupiter tests proportion through your own yeses. The bill often arrives after the shine fades. Before you add another commitment, find the hours or money it will actually use. A big plan can still work. It needs more than confidence to carry it.
